# FLX-7135: a run's emitted stream cannot be read as a table

**Family:** calibration (the 7000 band)

The queries read the files under the run's emits/ directory, and only those, without following a link. A stream is one row per line, each a JSON array of as many values as the contract's columns, and no float. The message names the stream and the line; it never quotes a value. Run apply again, and do not edit a file under emits/.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-7135
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
